// Generated by Cypress Author — 2026-11-17.
// CF-F01 contract: QA/Test-Cases/EZPOST_QA_CUSTOMER_FORM_TEST_CASES.md.
// One independent assisted journey. All account data remains private in memory.
import { liveCheckout } from '../../support/authenticated-checkout-runtime';
import owned from '../../support/authenticated-checkout-contract.cjs';
import fixture from '../../fixtures/cart-observed.json';
import { ui, text, compact, replayPresentation, afterBrowserRender, pressButtonEnter } from '../../support/ordering';

const sessionPath = '/api/v1/auth/session', cartPath = '/api/v1/cart';
let baseline, entry, addAttempted = false, locations;

// Shared pure identity/oracle/guard are reused. The assisted setup remains
// self-contained so this spec never depends on a previous spec/session cache.
const field = name => cy.get('main form[data-cy="checkout-form"] [autocomplete="' + name + '"]', { log: false });
function input(name, value) {
  field(name === 'street-address' ? 'tel' : 'street-address').should($el =>
    liveCheckout().check('incompleteAddressSentinelBeforeEdit', $el[0].value === ''));
  field(name).should('be.visible').clear({ log: false });
  if (value !== '') {
    if (name === 'name' || name === 'street-address') {
      // minLength is evaluated only for native user edits. The initial .type
      // run and isolated native-input probe exposed this distinction. Keep the
      // tooShort oracle; send supported native keys to the intended control.
      field(name).should('be.focused');
      for (const character of value) cy.press(character, { log: false });
    } else field(name).type(value, { log: false });
  }
  const max = { name: 120, tel: 11, 'postal-code': 10, 'street-address': 300 }[name];
  const expected = (name === 'tel' || name === 'postal-code' ? value.replace(/\D/g, '') : value).slice(0, max);
  field(name).should($el => liveCheckout().check('actualInputMatchesIntent_' + name.replaceAll('-', '_'), $el[0].value === expected));
}
function validity(name, valid, flag) {
  field(name).should($field => {
    const el = $field[0], gate = liveCheckout();
    gate.check('native_' + name.replaceAll('-', '_') + '_' + (flag || 'valid'), el.validity.valid === valid && (!flag || el.validity[flag]));
    if (!valid) gate.check('nativeFeedbackAvailable', el.validationMessage.length > 0);
  });
}
function selectBox(level) {
  return field(level).parents('.checkout-select').should('have.length', 1);
}
function selectLocation(level, item) {
  selectBox(level).find('.checkout-select__trigger').should('be.visible').and('be.enabled').click();
  selectBox(level).find('.checkout-select__menu[role="listbox"]').should('be.visible')
    .contains('li[role="option"] .checkout-select__item-title', new RegExp('^' + Cypress._.escapeRegExp(item.title) + '$'))
    .should('have.length', 1).click();
  field(level).should('have.value', String(item.code)); // Observe only; never select hidden UI.
  selectBox(level).find('.checkout-select__label').should('have.text', item.title);
}
function exerciseForm() {
  const gate = liveCheckout();
  gate.phase('testing-form', '/checkout');
  cy.wait('@formLocations', { log: false }).then(({ response }) => {
    gate.check('liveLocationDataHasProvinceCities', response?.statusCode === 200 &&
      Array.isArray(response.body?.items) && response.body.items.every(p =>
        p && p.code !== undefined && typeof p.title === 'string' && Array.isArray(p.cities) &&
        p.cities.every(c => c && c.code !== undefined && typeof c.title === 'string')));
    locations = response.body.items.filter(p => p.cities.length > 0)
      .filter((p, index, all) => all.findIndex(other => String(other.code) === String(p.code)) === index);
    gate.check('twoSuppliedProvincesForDependency', locations.length >= 2);
  });
  // No pre-existing draft was permitted. Never overwrite a restored address.
  const expectedFields = {
    name: { type: 'text', min: 2, max: 120, pattern: null },
    tel: { type: 'text', min: -1, max: 11, pattern: '09[0-9]{9}' },
    'postal-code': { type: 'text', min: -1, max: 10, pattern: '[0-9]{10}' },
    'street-address': { type: 'textarea', min: 10, max: 300, pattern: null }
  };
  for (const name of Object.keys(expectedFields)) {
    field(name).should($el => {
      const el = $el[0], expected = expectedFields[name];
      gate.check('exactNativeContract_' + name.replaceAll('-', '_'), el.required &&
        el.type === expected.type && el.minLength === expected.min && el.maxLength === expected.max &&
        el.getAttribute('pattern') === expected.pattern);
    });
    field(name).should($el => gate.check('initialFieldsActuallyEmpty', $el[0].value === ''));
    validity(name, false, 'valueMissing');
  }
  // Native contract only; custom two-token name validation is not invoked.
  input('name', 'X'); validity('name', false, 'tooShort');
  input('name', 'QA'); validity('name', true);
  input('name', 'X'.repeat(121));
  field('name').should($el => gate.check('nameNativeMaxLengthEnforced', $el[0].value.length === 120));
  validity('name', true); input('name', 'QA Tester');
  // Actual Tab operation between observed consecutive controls; never Enter/submit.
  field('name').click(); cy.press(Cypress.Keyboard.Keys.TAB);
  field('tel').should('be.focused');
  cy.then(() => gate.check('keyboardTabReachesRecipientMobile', true));
  // Synthetic in-memory markers. Address remains blank throughout these edits.
  input('tel', '12'); validity('tel', false, 'patternMismatch');
  input('tel', '08' + '1'.repeat(9)); validity('tel', false, 'patternMismatch');
  input('tel', '09' + '1'.repeat(8)); validity('tel', false, 'patternMismatch');
  input('tel', '09' + '1'.repeat(9)); validity('tel', true);
  input('tel', '09' + '1'.repeat(10));
  field('tel').should($el => gate.check('mobileNativeMaxLengthEnforced', $el[0].value.length === 11));
  input('tel', '\u06f0\u06f9\u06f1');
  field('tel').should($el => gate.check('persianDigitsFollowObservedFilter', $el[0].value === ''));
  input('tel', '\u0660\u0669\u0661');
  field('tel').should($el => gate.check('arabicDigitsFollowObservedFilter', $el[0].value === ''));
  input('tel', '09' + '1'.repeat(9)); validity('tel', true);
  input('postal-code', '1'.repeat(9)); validity('postal-code', false, 'patternMismatch');
  input('postal-code', '1'.repeat(10)); validity('postal-code', true);
  input('postal-code', '1'.repeat(11));
  field('postal-code').should($el => gate.check('postalNativeMaxLengthEnforced', $el[0].value.length === 10));
  input('postal-code', '\u06f1\u0662');
  field('postal-code').should($el => gate.check('localizedPostalDigitsFollowObservedFilter', $el[0].value === ''));
  input('postal-code', '1'.repeat(10)); validity('postal-code', true);
  // Before making address nonempty, invalidate mobile through the normal UI.
  input('tel', ''); validity('tel', false, 'valueMissing');
  input('street-address', 'X'.repeat(9)); validity('street-address', false, 'tooShort');
  input('street-address', 'X'.repeat(10)); validity('street-address', true);
  input('street-address', 'X'.repeat(301));
  field('street-address').should($el => gate.check('addressNativeMaxLengthEnforced', $el[0].value.length === 300));
  validity('street-address', true);
  // Reset sentinel through normal editing; never set/remove storage directly.
  input('street-address', ''); validity('street-address', false, 'valueMissing');
  selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__trigger').should('be.disabled');
  selectBox('address-level1').find('.checkout-select__trigger').click();
  selectBox('address-level1').find('.checkout-select__menu').should('be.visible');
  // Native activation of the focused type=button, not a form submit.
  selectBox('address-level1').find('.checkout-select__trigger').focus().should('be.focused');
  pressButtonEnter();
  selectBox('address-level1').find('.checkout-select__menu').should('not.exist');
  cy.then(() => gate.check('keyboardClosesOpenedProvinceList', true));
  cy.then(() => {
    selectLocation('address-level1', locations[0]);
    selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__trigger').should('be.enabled').click();
    selectBox('address-level2').find('li[role="option"] .checkout-select__item-title').should($items => {
      const actual = $items.toArray().map(el => el.textContent.trim()).sort();
      const expected = locations[0].cities.map(c => c.title).sort();
      gate.check('cityOptionsMatchChosenProvinceData', JSON.stringify(actual) === JSON.stringify(expected));
    });
    selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__menu')
      .contains('.checkout-select__item-title', new RegExp('^' + Cypress._.escapeRegExp(locations[0].cities[0].title) + '$')).click();
    field('address-level2').should('have.value', String(locations[0].cities[0].code));
    selectLocation('address-level1', locations[1]);
    field('address-level2').should('have.value', '');
    selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__trigger').should('have.class', 'checkout-select__trigger--empty');
    selectLocation('address-level2', locations[1].cities[0]);
  });
  function checkDraft(expectedName) {
    cy.window({ log: false }).then(win => {
      const raw = win.sessionStorage.getItem('ezpost_checkout_address');
      const draft = raw === null ? null : JSON.parse(raw);
      gate.check('testOwnedDraftMatchesIndependentInput', Boolean(draft &&
        draft.recipient_name === expectedName && draft.recipient_mobile === '' &&
        draft.postal_code === '1'.repeat(10) && draft.address_line === '' &&
        draft.province_code === locations[1].code && draft.province === locations[1].title &&
        draft.city_code === locations[1].cities[0].code && draft.city === locations[1].cities[0].title &&
        win.sessionStorage.getItem('ezpost_active_order_id') === null));
    });
  }
  checkDraft('QA Tester');
  cy.viewport(390, 844);
  for (const name of ['name', 'tel', 'postal-code', 'street-address']) {
    field(name).should('be.visible').should($el => {
      const box = $el[0].getBoundingClientRect();
      gate.check('narrowFieldsInsideHorizontalViewport', box.left >= 0 && box.right <= 390);
    });
  }
  // Change the visible narrow UI; assert the action really reached its state.
  input('name', 'QA Narrow');
  field('name').should($el => gate.check('narrowNameEditReflected', $el[0].value === 'QA Narrow'));
  selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__trigger').should('be.visible').and('be.enabled').click();
  selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__menu').should('be.visible');
  selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__trigger').click();
  selectBox('address-level2').find('.checkout-select__menu').should('not.exist');
  cy.then(() => gate.check('narrowCustomCityListActuallyToggled', true));
  checkDraft('QA Narrow');
  validity('tel', false, 'valueMissing'); validity('street-address', false, 'valueMissing');
  for (const name of ['name', 'postal-code', 'tel', 'street-address']) input(name, '');
  cy.viewport(1366, 900);
  session();
  readCart(items => { owned.discoverOwned(baseline, items, entry.intent); gate.check('partialFormEditingPreservesCart', true); });
  cy.then(() => gate.check('noShippingOrPersistenceAttempted', gate.status.blockedMutations === 0));
}

function session(first = false) {
  const gate = liveCheckout();
  return cy.request({ method: 'GET', url: sessionPath, log: false, failOnStatusCode: false }).then(res => {
    gate.check('ordinaryIdentityRemainsIntended', res.status === 200 &&
      (first ? gate.matchesSession(res.body?.user) : gate.sameSession(res.body?.user)));
    if (first) gate.rememberSession(res.body.user);
  });
}
function readCart(callback) {
  return cy.request({ method: 'GET', url: cartPath, log: false, failOnStatusCode: false }).then(res => {
    liveCheckout().check('realCartReadValid', res.status === 200 && Array.isArray(res.body?.items));
    callback(res.body.items);
  });
}
function line() {
  return cy.get('main [data-cy="cart-item"]').filter((_, el) => {
    const src = el.querySelector('.cart-thumb img')?.getAttribute('src');
    return Boolean(src && new URL(src, Cypress.config('baseUrl')).pathname.startsWith(
      '/api/v1/products/' + entry.product.slug + '/images/'));
  }).should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible');
}
function draftsAbsent() {
  return cy.window({ log: false }).then(win => liveCheckout().check('noPreExistingDraftBeforeMutation',
    win.sessionStorage.getItem('ezpost_active_order_id') === null &&
    win.sessionStorage.getItem('ezpost_checkout_address') === null));
}
function registerFrom(items) {
  const gate = liveCheckout();
  const id = owned.identifyOwned(baseline, items, entry.intent);
  gate.registerOwned(id); // Before quantity/presentation assertions so cleanup survives them.
  owned.discoverOwned(baseline, items, entry.intent);
  gate.check('newOwnedIdAndUntouchedBaseline', true);
}
function cleanupOwned() {
  const gate = liveCheckout();
  if (!addAttempted) { gate.cleanup('not-needed'); return; }
  gate.phase('cleanup');
  session();
  readCart(items => {
    if (gate.ownedId() === undefined) {
      // A failed post-Add assertion may precede registration. Reconcile privately.
      if (owned.restored(baseline, items)) { gate.cleanup('not-needed'); return; }
      registerFrom(items);
    }
    gate.cleanup('removing-owned');
    cy.visit('/cart');
    line().contains('button', /^حذف$/).should('be.visible').and('be.enabled');
    cy.intercept('POST', '/api/v1/cart/items/' + encodeURIComponent(gate.ownedId()) + '/remove').as('ownedRemove');
    line().contains('button', /^حذف$/).click();
    cy.wait('@ownedRemove', { log: false }).then(({ response }) =>
      gate.check('ownedRemoveCompleted', response?.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 300));
    readCart(after => gate.check('originalCartRestoredExactly', owned.restored(baseline, after)));
    draftsAbsent();
    cy.then(() => {
      gate.check('exactlyOneNormalAddAndOwnedRemove', gate.counts().addCount === 1 && gate.counts().removeCount === 1);
      gate.check('noForbiddenWriteAttempted', gate.status.blockedMutations === 0);
      gate.cleanup('restored');
    });
  });
}

describe('Actual customer form with deliberately incomplete synthetic address', () => {
  beforeEach(() => { baseline = undefined; entry = undefined; addAttempted = false; });
  afterEach(function () {
    const gate = liveCheckout();
    // No mutation setup is manufactured. Cleanup cannot select an existing line.
    cleanupOwned();
    cy.then(() => gate.phase(this.currentTest.state === 'passed' ? 'completed' : 'failed'));
  });

  it('CF-F01 — native validation, correction and province-city selection preserve cart without saving or ordering', () => {
    const gate = liveCheckout();
    cy.intercept('GET', sessionPath).as('guestSession');
    cy.visit('/cart');
    // Initial Chrome evidence: 100+ cold dev-module GETs preceded the real
    // session request, which completed after Cypress's default request window.
    // Bound only this initial hydration wait; identity/status oracle unchanged.
    cy.wait('@guestSession', { log: false, requestTimeout: 30000 }).then(({ response }) => gate.check('freshGuestBeforeLogin',
      response?.statusCode === 200 && response.body?.user === null));
    cy.get('main .commerce-empty').should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible');
    cy.get('main [data-cy="cart-item"]').should('not.exist');
    draftsAbsent();
    cy.get('header a[aria-label="حساب کاربری"]').should('have.attr', 'href', '/login').click();
    cy.location('pathname').should('eq', '/login');
    cy.get('main [data-cy="login-form"] #mobile').should('be.visible').and('have.value', '');
    cy.then(() => gate.phase('awaiting-phone', '/login'));
    cy.then({ timeout: 30 * 60 * 1000 }, () => gate.waitForVerification()).then(result => {
      gate.check('manualVerificationReturnedSuccess', result.succeeded);
      gate.check('singleManualStartAndVerify', gate.status.otpStartCount === 1 && gate.status.otpVerifyCount === 1);
    });
    session(true);
    cy.request({ method: 'GET', url: '/api/v1/auth/me', log: false, failOnStatusCode: false }).then(res =>
      gate.check('independentMeConfirmsOrdinaryIdentity', res.status === 200 && gate.matchesMe(res.body)));
    cy.get('header a[aria-label="حساب کاربری"]').should('have.attr', 'href', '/account');

    cy.then(() => gate.phase('initial-cart', '/cart'));
    cy.visit('/cart');
    readCart(items => {
      owned.snapshot(items); baseline = structuredClone(items);
      const product = !items.some(row => row.product_slug === fixture.blackFriday.slug) ? fixture.blackFriday :
        !items.some(row => row.product_slug === fixture.simple.slug) ? fixture.simple : null;
      gate.check('independentKnownProductAbsentFromBaseline', product !== null);
      entry = { product, pack: product.default, quantity: product === fixture.blackFriday ? 2 : 1 };
      entry.intent = { slug: product.slug, packageId: entry.pack.id, quantity: entry.quantity };
    });
    draftsAbsent();
    cy.then(() => {
      gate.phase('selecting-product', entry.product.path);
      cy.intercept('POST', '/api/v1/products/' + entry.product.slug + '/quote').as('selectionQuote');
      cy.visit(entry.product.path);
      cy.get('main h1').should('have.text', entry.product.name).and('be.visible');
      const verifyQuote = q => cy.wait('@selectionQuote', { log: false }).then(({ request, response }) => {
        gate.check('quoteCorrelatesExactSelection', request.body?.package_id === entry.pack.id && request.body?.quantity === q &&
          response?.statusCode === 200 && response.body?.package_id === entry.pack.id && response.body.quantity === q &&
          response.body.labels_per_package === entry.pack.labels && response.body.labels_total === entry.pack.labels * q &&
          Number.isSafeInteger(response.body.line_total_irr) && response.body.line_total_irr >= 0);
        entry.amount = response.body.line_total_irr;
        replayPresentation(response.body);
      });
      verifyQuote(1);
      if (entry.quantity === 2) {
        cy.get(ui.increase).should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible').and('be.enabled').click(); verifyQuote(2);
      }
      cy.get('main .package-options-grid button.is-selected .package-card-title').should('have.text', entry.pack.title);
      cy.get(ui.quantity).should('have.value', String(entry.quantity));
      session();
      readCart(items => gate.check('baselineStillIntactImmediatelyBeforeAdd', owned.restored(baseline, items)));
      cy.then(() => { gate.armAdd(entry.intent); gate.phase('adding-owned-item'); addAttempted = true; });
      cy.intercept('POST', '/api/v1/cart/items').as('normalAdd');
      cy.get('main [data-cy="add-to-cart"]').should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible').and('be.enabled').click();
      cy.wait('@normalAdd', { log: false }).then(({ response }) => gate.check('authenticatedAddNotGuestFallback',
        response?.statusCode >= 200 && response.statusCode < 300));
      cy.location('pathname').should('eq', '/cart');
      readCart(registerFrom);
      line().should($line => {
        gate.check('ownedCartNameMatchesIntent', $line.find('h2').text().trim() === entry.product.name);
        gate.check('ownedCartQuantityMatchesIntent', text($line.find('.cart-quantity-val').text()) === String(entry.quantity));
        gate.check('ownedCartLabelsMatchIntent', text($line.find('.cart-item__info small').text()) === entry.pack.labels + ' بارکد در هر بسته');
        gate.check('quoteToCartPresentationMatches', compact($line.find('.cart-item__price').text()) === entry.amount + 'ریال');
      });
      session();
      cy.then(() => gate.phase('checking-checkout', '/cart'));
      cy.intercept('GET', '/api/v1/shipping/locations').as('formLocations');
      cy.get('main .order-summary a[href="/checkout"]').should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible').click();
      cy.location('pathname').should('eq', '/checkout');
      cy.get('main form[data-cy="checkout-form"]').should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible');
      cy.then(() => gate.phase('inspecting-form', '/checkout'));
      readCart(items => { owned.discoverOwned(baseline, items, entry.intent); gate.check('populatedHandoffPreservesCart', true); });
      // Actual rendered metadata only, never .value, options text or account DOM.
      cy.get('main form[data-cy="checkout-form"]').should($form => {
        const inventory = [];
        for (const field of ['name', 'tel', 'postal-code', 'street-address']) {
          const $field = $form.find('[autocomplete="' + field + '"]');
          gate.check('renderedField_' + field.replace('-', '_'), $field.length === 1 && $field.is(':visible'));
          const el = $field[0];
          inventory.push({ autocomplete: field, tag: el.tagName, type: el.type,
            required: el.required, minLength: el.minLength, maxLength: el.maxLength,
            pattern: el.getAttribute('pattern'), visible: true });
        }
        // Explicit metadata allowlist. No values, names, labels or account data.
        Cypress.expose('checkoutFormInventory', inventory);
        gate.check('renderedProvinceAndCityControls', $form.find('.checkout-select__trigger').length === 2);
        const submit = $form.find('.checkout-submit-btn');
        gate.check('orderSubmitBoundaryIdentified', submit.length === 1 && submit[0].type === 'submit');
        gate.check('shippingActionBoundaryIdentified', $form.find('.shipping-quote__btn[type="button"]').length === 1);
      });
      cy.get('main .checkout-summary__item').filter((_, el) => {
        const src = el.querySelector('img')?.getAttribute('src');
        return Boolean(src && new URL(src, Cypress.config('baseUrl')).pathname.startsWith(
          '/api/v1/products/' + entry.product.slug + '/images/'));
      }).should('have.length', 1).and('be.visible').should($row => {
        gate.check('reviewOwnedProductNameMatches', $row.find('p').clone().children().remove().end().text().trim() === entry.product.name);
        gate.check('reviewOwnedQuantityMatches', text($row.find('p small').text()) === entry.quantity + ' بسته');
        gate.check('reviewOwnedAmountPresentationMatches', compact($row.find('strong').text()) === entry.amount + 'ریال');
      });
      cy.then(exerciseForm);
      afterBrowserRender();
      session();
    });
  });
});
